messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from behind. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video, then follow the described camera setup and movement. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from behind. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands in profile, then turns to face away from the camera and raises one arm to touch her hair.","camera":"A static, low-angle full-body shot from behind and to the side of the subject.","clothing":"A short, blue-and-white patterned one-piece dress with a low back, and red flat shoes.","hair_color":"Blonde.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair pulled back into a ponytail.","identity":"A slender woman with a slim build, shown in profile and then from behind.","scene":"An outdoor amusement-park or fairground plaza with a striped carousel on the left, a thatched-roof building on the right, and a hazy sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output begins with a low-angle full-body view from behind and to the side, matching the reference framing with the subject centered in a fairground plaza. The woman remains blonde with a ponytail, wearing the same blue-and-white patterned dress and red flats. She stands, turns, and raises an arm to touch her hair, broadly following the source action progression.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a full-body shot from behind, using the reference image for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, environment, and action timing.
uncertain: Whether the action timing and progression exactly match the source video frame by frame.
unexpected_changes: The environment was replaced with a different fairground layout: striped carousel on the left, thatched-roof building on the right, and a hazy sky instead of the source's Ferris wheel and sunset scene.
The subject's initial pose is more static and profile-oriented than the source's initial standing pose, and the arm-to-hair motion appears later in the sequence.
The output has visible letterboxing and a different aspect ratio than the source.
